batten.label: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
batten.summary: A group of inherited brain diseases (often called Batten disease) in which waste material builds up inside cells' recycling centres, the lysosomes.

batten.label: CLN2 disease
batten.summary: A form of Batten disease that starts in toddlers with seizures and loss of skills. An enzyme replacement therapy is approved.

batten.label: CLN3 disease

lysosom.label: Lysosomal degradation (ceroid lipofuscin storage)
lysosom.summary: Cells break down worn-out parts inside lysosomes. In all NCLs this recycling fails and waste (lipofuscin) builds up, especially in nerve cells.

lysosom.label: Lysosomal/ER membrane protein dysfunction
lysosom.summary: A broken protein that is built into a membrane (of the lysosome or the endoplasmic reticulum). It cannot simply be replaced by an infusion.

lysosom.label: Soluble lysosomal enzyme deficiency
lysosom.summary: A missing enzyme that normally floats free inside the lysosome. Because it is soluble, it can sometimes be replaced with a manufactured version (enzyme replacement).
